# Domain summary

## Laboratory Medicine (`laboratory_medicine`)

Controlled vocabulary, look-alike hazards, reference intervals, protocols and specimen-sequencing rules for laboratory decision support.

> Reference values in this pack are demonstration values generated by reference_agent/gemini-2.5-pro. They are NOT clinically validated (intervals carry clinically_unvalidated: true and verified_by: null). Do not use in production clinical systems without laboratory sign-off.
